Deliverables.title: What's Included
Deliverables.description: Our comprehensive food delivery app solution includes everything you need to launch and scale your business — from customer apps to restaurant panels, delivery driver apps, admin dashboards, payment gateways, and more.

deliverables.title: Customer App (iOS + Android)
deliverables.description: Native-feel apps with Google/Truecaller login, Hinglish search, real-time order tracking, UPI payments, and push notifications. Optimized for Tier 1, 2, and 3 cities across India.

deliverables.title: Restaurant Vendor App
